Subject: Ledger sync: PO timing and invoice slate for Q3 bookings

Hi Julia / Acme procurement —

Quick check-in ahead of our quarter close: we have the booked orders tied to the ACME-2028-Q3-0456 contract that need a confirmed PO and an agreed invoice window so we can recognize bookings in July. To avoid a recognition delay, we need the PO to be received and acknowledged by noon PT on 2028-07-26. If Acme needs the invoice dated differently (e.g., backdated to July 31 vs. August 1) please flag that now so we can align finance.

Requested next steps (simple):
- Please confirm PO number and attach the signed PO to this thread.
- Confirm whether Acme needs a July or August invoice date.
- If procurement requires a different invoice sequencing (split invoices / milestone invoice), advise by EOD 7/25.

Ben / Laura / Karthik — FYI. Ben, can you validate the invoice-window matrix and confirm the latest acceptable PO receipt timestamp? I attached the PO template and the invoice-window matrix for reference.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Revenue Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_PO_Template_070328.pdf (application/pdf), Invoice-window-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledger sync: PO timing and invoice slate for Q3 bookings

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the heads up. We're aligning with Legal & Procurement; a couple quick items:
1) We can issue a PO but need to confirm final payment terms (Net30 vs Net45) with Legal — ETA EOD 7/25.
2) Acme prefers that the invoice be dated 2028-07-31 so the spend sits in Q3 for our internal reporting.
3) If Redwood requires PO acknowledgment to proceed with recognition on 7/31, please confirm the acknowledgement process (email confirmation vs portal upload).

I'll loop Procurement on the signed PO once Legal signs off. Tentative PO sender will be procurement@acmecloud.com.

Best,
Julia Park
Vendor Ops Manager
Acme Cloud

Priya / team —

Confirming our internal deadlines and constraints so we can give Acme a clear answer:
- Latest PO receipt for a July 31 recognition is 2028-07-26 12:00 PT (to allow accounting to process and include in July close).
- We can accept the PO via email (procurement@redwood.com) or via DocuSign upload to the account portal; email acknowledgement will be issued within 2 business hours of receipt.
- If Acme needs Net45, revenue recognition dates won't change but cash timing will — make sure Sales/Finance are aware.

Action items for this thread:
- Priya: confirm to Acme that an email-based PO is acceptable and that we'll acknowledge receipt via reply within 2 hours.
- Laura: flag any contract clauses that would prevent recognition on 7/31 if the invoice date is 7/31.
- Karthik: prepare the draft invoice (dated 2028-07-31) and attach when PO is received. Use the invoice-window-matrix.xlsx logic for split invoices if needed.

I'll stand by to issue the ack once we get the PO.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
